info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Status Retrieval API allows users to access the current status of tickets for various events within the ticketing system. Leveraging a straightforward GET request, this endpoint provides real-time information about ticket availability, including active, sold-out, and reserved statuses. It is particularly useful for event organizers, ticketing agents, and consumers interested in understanding ticket dynamics for effective planning. This API facilitates informed decision-making regarding ticket purchases and event attendance.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of tickets in the system. It provides valuable information regarding the state of each ticket, which can be useful for both users and administrators to monitor ticket progress and identify any issues.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of tickets. It may include parameters that stipulate which tickets to check their status for, allowing for better filtering and specificity in the response.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.title: Ticket Status Request Body
ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of a ticket. The expected format is a string representing the ticket's status.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Response schema for the ticket status operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.
